harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, and the preposition [phrase] is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) (أقسم, "I swear"). «صفا»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), governed by «الصافات».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «فالزاجرات»: a conjoined noun, and «زجرا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: (إن إلهكم لواحد) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is the response to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «رب»: second khabar (predicate) of {إِنَّ}. «ما»: a relative noun conjoined to «السماوات». «بينهما»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «وحفظا»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governing word is implied, i.e.: We guarded it with a guarding; the governing word is conjoined to the preceding clause {زَيَّنَّا}. The preposition «من كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied governing word «حفظناها».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «لا يسَّمَّعون» is resumptive, and the verb is made to carry (mudammin) the sense of «لا يُصْغون» ("they do not incline their ears"). It cannot be adjectival, since there is no sense in guarding against a devil that does not listen.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «دحورا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); it is synonymous with «يُقذفون». The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause {لا يَسَّمَّعُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: His words «مَن»: a relative noun, accusative as the excepted. «الخطفة»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «فأتبعه» is conjoined to the clause «خطف».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «فاستفتهم» is resumptive. The interrogative clause is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «استفتهم», which is made to carry the sense of a verb of the heart. «خلقا»: tamyīz (specification). His words «مَن»: a relative noun conjoined to «هم», and «أم» is a connected (muttaṣila) conjunction.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «عجبت» is resumptive. The clause «ويسخرون» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being «هم»; the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the wāw is circumstantial.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: (وإذا ذكروا لا يذكرون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «يسخرون».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: (وإذا رأوا آية يستسخرون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding clause.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «وقالوا» is conjoined to the clause that is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and «إنْ» is negating.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis, i.e.: we will be resurrected. The clause «إنا لمبعوثون» is explicative of the apodosis; this clause cannot be the apodosis of «إذا», because what comes after «إنّ» does not govern what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «آباؤنا»: mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being «مبعوثون»; the clause of the mubtadaʾ and khabar is conjoined to the clause «إنا لمبعوثون».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) is implied, i.e.: yes, you will be resurrected. The clause «وأنتم داخرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تبعثون».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «فإنما هي زجرة» is resumptive, and the clause «فإذا هم ينظرون» is conjoined to the resumptive [clause]; «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya).

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «وقالوا» is conjoined to the clause {هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ}, and the clause «هذا يوم الدين» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «هذا يوم الفصل» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of a new speech. «الذي»: naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «احشروا» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied speech. «وأزواجهم»: a noun conjoined to «الذين», and «ما» is a relative noun conjoined to «أزواجهم».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. The clause «فاهدوهم» is conjoined to the clause {احْشُرُوا}.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «لا تناصرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The interrogative clause is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied speech.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The adverb «اليوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «مستسلمون».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «وأقبل» is resumptive, and the clause «يتساءلون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «أقبل».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The preposition «عن اليمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) in «تأتوننا».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) is implied, i.e.: we did not lead you astray; rather, you were not... The clause «لم تكونوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «وما كان لنا عليكم من سلطان» is conjoined to the clause {لَمْ تَكُونُوا}. The preposition «لنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the preposition «عليكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «سلطان»; «سلطان» is the noun of «كان», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «كنتم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «فحق» is conjoined to the clause {كُنْتُمْ}, and the clause «إنَّا لذائقون» is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «فأغويناكم» is conjoined to the clause {لَمْ تَكُونُوا}, and the clause «إنَّا كنا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «فإنهم يومئذ مشتركون» is resumptive, and the prepositional phrase and the adverb are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «مشتركون».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: (إنا كذلك نفعل بالمجرمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We do a doing like that doing.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «إذا»: a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يستكبرون». The clause of declaring [Allah] transcendent (tanzīh) is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied speech. «الله»: badal (substitute) of the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause «يستكبرون» is the khabar of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «ويقولون» is conjoined to the clause {يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ}. The preposition «لشاعر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تاركو».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جاء», and the clause «جاء» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: (إنكم لذائقو العذاب الأليم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «ما»: a relative noun, second object, and «إلا» is for restriction.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: (إلا عباد الله المخلصين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] [«عباد» is] excepted in a disjoined exception, and «المخلصين» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «لهم رزق» is the khabar (predicate) of «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «فواكه»: badal (substitute) of {رِزْقٌ}. The clause «وهم مكرمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «لهم».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The preposition «في جنات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {مُكْرَمُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The preposition «على سرر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متقابلين», and «متقابلين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in {مُكْرَمُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «يطاف» is resumptive. «عليهم»: a preposition and its genitive noun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The preposition «بكأس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يطاف», and the preposition «من معين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «كأس».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: «بيضاء»: second naʿt (adjective) of «كأس»; «لذة»: third naʿt; «للشاربين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «لذة».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The clause «لا فيها غول» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كأس»; «غول» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «ولا هم ينزفون» is conjoined to the nominal clause, and the preposition «عنها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينزفون».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «عندهم قاصرات» is conjoined to the clause {يُطَافُ}. «عين»: naʿt (adjective) of «قاصرات».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: (كأنهن بيض مكنون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of {قَاصِرَاتُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «فأقبل» is resumptive. The preposition «على بعض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أقبل», and the clause «يتساءلون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «بعضهم».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «قال قائل» is resumptive. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قائل». The clause «كان لي قرين» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «يقول» is a naʿt (adjective) of {قَرِينٌ}, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «إذا»: adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis, "we will be resurrected". The clause «متنا» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct), and the clause «أئنا لمدينون» is explicative of the apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The clause «فاطلع» is conjoined to the clause {قَالَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «إنْ» is lightened from the heavy [إنّ] and left inoperative, and the lām is the distinguishing one (al-lām al-fāriqa). «تردين»: an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ; the nūn is that of protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ, dropped for lightness, is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «تردين» is the khabar (predicate) of «كاد», and the clause «إن كدت لتردين» is the response to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the response to the oath. «نعمة»: mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing".

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «ما» acts like «ليس», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in its khabar (predicate). The clause is conjoined to the content of an implied speech, i.e.: the people of Paradise said: Are we to abide forever? So we are not going to die.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «موتتنا»: excepted in a disjoined exception; «الأولى»: naʿt (adjective). The clause «وما نحن بمعذبين» is conjoined to the clause «ما نحن بميتين», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: (إن هذا لهو الفوز العظيم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «الفوز» its khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: (لمثل هذا فليعمل العاملون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعمل»; «هذا» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the lām is of the command, making [the verb] jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «ذلك خير» is resumptive. «نزلا»: tamyīz (specification). The connected (muttaṣila) «أم» is a conjunction, and «شجرة» is a noun conjoined to the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ذلك».

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «فتنةً»: second object, and the clause is resumptive. The preposition «للظالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فتنة».

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The clause «طلعها كأنه رءوس» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «شجرة».

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The clause «فإنهم لآكلون» is resumptive; the preposition «منها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آكلون». His words «فمالئون»: conjoined to «آكلون»; «البطون» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle «مالئون», and the second preposition «منها» is attached to «مالئون».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The preposition «عليها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «حميم», and the lām is for emphasis. The preposition «من حميم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «شوبا». The clause is conjoined to the clause «إنهم لآكلون».

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: (ثم إن مرجعهم لإلى الجحيم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause «إن لهم لشوبا», and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «ألفوا» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and «ضالين» is the second object of «ألفى».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: (فهم على آثارهم يهرعون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا}; the clause «يهرعون» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «ولقد ضلَّ قبلهم» is resumptive; «أكثر» is the fāʿil (agent).

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The clause «ولقد أرسلنا» is conjoined to the clause «لقد ضلَّ». «منذرين»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The clause «فانظر» is resumptive. The clause «كيف كان» is the object of the looking, which carries the sense of knowing and is suspended [from operating] by the interrogative; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, khabar (predicate) of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: «عباد»: excepted in a disjoined exception, and «المخلصين» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The clause «ولقد نادانا نوح» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد نادانا» is the response to the oath. The fāʾ is a conjunction, and the lām occurs in the response to the oath; the clause is conjoined to the preceding response to the oath, and there is no need to assume a second oath. The one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, its implied form being «نحن», and «المجيبون» is the fāʿil (agent) of «نِعْم».

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: The clause «ونجيناه» is conjoined to the clause that is the preceding response to the oath. His words «وأهله»: a noun conjoined to the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «هم»: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). «وجعلنا» takes two objects: «ذريته» and «الباقين».

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: The clause «وتركنا» is conjoined to the clause «جعلنا». The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the object of «تركنا» is implied as something like: praise.

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: (سلام على نوح في العالمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is explicative of the preceding implied object. «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition after it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it denotes a supplication. The preposition «في العالمين» is attached to the [notion of] being established (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: He recompenses those who do good with a recompense like that recompense. The clause «إنَّا نجزي» is resumptive, and the clause «نجزي» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: (إنه من عبادنا المؤمنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: (ثم أغرقنا الآخرين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause «تركنا» in verse (78).

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: (وإن من شيعته لإبراهيم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive; the lām is for emphasis, and the preposition «من شيعته» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, object of an implied (muqaddar) «اذكر» ("remember"). The clause «جاء» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The preposition «بقلب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «جاء».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, badal (substitute) of the preceding {إِذْ}. «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); «ذا»: a relative noun, its khabar (predicate); and the clause «تعبدون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: «إفكا»: object of «تريدون»; «آلهة»: badal (substitute); «دون»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «آلهة». The clause «تريدون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: (فما ظنكم برب العالمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause {تُرِيدُونَ}. «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ظنكم» is its khabar (predicate). The preposition «برب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ظنكم».

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The clause «فنظر» is resumptive; «نظرة» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: The clause «فقال» is conjoined to the clause «نظر».

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The clause «فتولَّوا» is conjoined to the clause «قال». The verb is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif, which was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). «مدبرين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: (فراغ إلى آلهتهم فقال ألا تأكلون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause «تَوَلَّوا». «ألا» is for offering (ʿarḍ).

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive within the scope of the speech. The clause «لا تنطقون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf in «لكم».

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: (فراغ عليهم ضربا باليمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause «قال» in verse (91). «ضربا»: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied verb, and the clause of the implied verb is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «راغ». The preposition «باليمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) «ضربا».

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The clause «فأقبلوا» is resumptive, and the clause «يزفُّون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «أقبلوا».

harrat-mujtaba:95-95.t: «ما»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: The clause «والله خلقكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw, and «ما» is a relative conjoined to the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: «بنيانا»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «فألقوه» is conjoined to the clause «ابنوا».

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: The preposition «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «كيدا», and «الأسفلين» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The clause «وقال» is resumptive. The preposition «إلى ربي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ذاهب». The clause «سيهدين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: «رب»: the one addressed, in a construct (munādā muḍāf), accusative with the yāʾ implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which was dropped for lightness. The vocative clause is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied speech. The clause «هب» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The preposition «من الصالحين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of an implied object, i.e.: a son being among the righteous.

harrat-mujtaba:101-101.t: The clause «فبشَّرناه» is conjoined to the preceding implied speech.

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The adverb «معه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (أعني, "I mean"); it is not attached to «بلغ», because that would require that both of them reached the age of striving together. His words «يا بني»: the one addressed, in a construct (munādā muḍāf), accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct). The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أني أذبحك» takes the place of the two objects of «رأى» of dreaming. «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» a relative noun, its khabar (predicate); the clause «ماذا ترى» is the object of the looking, which carries the sense of knowing and is suspended [from operating] by the interrogative. The clause «فانظر» is resumptive. His words «يا أبت»: the one addressed, in a construct, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which has been changed into tāʾ. The clause «ستجدني» is resumptive. The conditional clause is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «من الصابرين» is attached to the second object of (وجد).

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: (فلما أسلما وتله للجبين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause, and the clause of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: their patience became manifest.

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The clause «وناديناه» is conjoined to the clause {أَسْلَمَا}. «أنْ» is explicative (mufassira), and the vocative clause is explicative of the calling.

harrat-mujtaba:105-105.t: The clause «قد صدَّقت» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The clause «إنا نجزي» is resumptive, and the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We recompense those who do good with a recompense like that recompense.

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: The clause «لهو البلاء» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: (وتركنا عليه في الآخرين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the object of «تركنا» is implied as something like: praise.

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: (سلام على إبراهيم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is explicative of the preceding implied object. «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition after it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The clause «نجزي» is resumptive, and the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: We recompense those who do good with a recompense like that.

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: (إنه من عبادنا المؤمنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: The clause «وبشَّرناه» is conjoined to the clause {وَتَرَكْنَا}. «نبيا»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from «إسحاق». The preposition «من الصالحين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نبيا».

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: The preposition «من ذريتهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «محسن», and the clause «من ذريتهما محسن» is resumptive. The lām in «لنفسه» is for strengthening, because its governing word «ظالم» is an active participle, which is secondary [to the verb], so it is strengthened with the lām; «نفسه» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «ظالم». «مبين»: naʿt (adjective) of «ظالم».

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: (ولقد مننا على موسى وهارون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive, and the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath.

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: His words «وقومهما»: a noun conjoined to the hāʾ. The preposition «من الكرب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نجَّيناهما».

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: The clause «فكانوا هم الغالبين» is conjoined to the clause «نصرناهم», and the pronoun «هم» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: (وتركنا عليهما في الآخرين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the object of «تركنا» is implied.

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: (سلام على موسى وهارون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is explicative of the preceding implied object.

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: The clause «نجزي» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:122-122.t: (إنهما من عبادنا المؤمنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive, and «المؤمنين» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:123-123.t: (وإن إلياس لمن المرسلين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «المرسلين». «ألا» is for offering (ʿarḍ). The clause «قال» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:125-125.t: The clause «أتدعون» is resumptive. «أحسن»: the object of «تذر».

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: «الله»: badal (substitute) of {أَحْسَنَ}; «ربكم»: badal of the Divine Name; «الأولين»: naʿt (adjective) of «آبائكم».

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: The clause «فكذَّبوه» is conjoined to the clause {قَالَ} in verse (124), and the clause «فإنهم لمحضرون» is conjoined to the clause «كذَّبوه»; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:129-129.t: (وتركنا عليه في الآخرين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The two prepositional phrases are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the object of «تركنا» is implied, i.e.: praise.

harrat-mujtaba:130-130.t: (سلام على إل ياسين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is explicative of the implied object.

harrat-mujtaba:131-131.t: The clause «نجزي» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:132-132.t: (إنه من عبادنا المؤمنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:133-133.t: (وإن لوطا لمن المرسلين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:134-134.t: «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «المرسلين». «أهله»: a noun conjoined to the hāʾ. «أجمعين»: tawkīd (emphasis).

harrat-mujtaba:135-135.t: The preposition «في الغابرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عجوزا».

harrat-mujtaba:136-136.t: (ثم دمرنا الآخرين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause {نَجَّيْنَاهُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:137-137.t: (وإنكم لتمرون عليهم مصبحين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive. «مصبحين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تمرون»; it is from the complete (tāmm) «أصبح».

harrat-mujtaba:138-138.t: (وبالليل) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) conjoined to the preceding ḥāl, i.e.: and while being in the night. The clause «أفلا تعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:139-139.t: (وإن يونس لمن المرسلين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:140-140.t: «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) {الْمُرْسَلِينَ}, and the clause «أبق» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:141-141.t: The clause «فكان» is conjoined to the clause «فساهم».

harrat-mujtaba:142-142.t: The clause «وهو مليم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in the clause «التقمه».

harrat-mujtaba:143-143.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to «التقمه». «أن» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is a mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing", i.e.: were it not that his being among those who glorify [Allah] existed.

harrat-mujtaba:144-144.t: The preposition «إلى يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لبث», and the clause «يبعثون» is muḍāf ilayhi (in genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:145-145.t: The clause «فنبذناه» is resumptive, and the clause «وهو سقيم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:146-146.t: The preposition «من يقطين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «شجرة».

harrat-mujtaba:147-147.t: «أو» here is for permission (ibāḥa), i.e.: one looking at them is permitted to estimate them at this amount or at this amount. The clause «يزيدون» is conjoined to the clause «أرسلناه».

harrat-mujtaba:148-148.t: The clause «فآمنوا» is conjoined to the clause «أرسلناه».

harrat-mujtaba:149-149.t: (فاستفتهم ألربك البنات ولهم البنون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive, and the interrogative clause after it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «استفتهم», which is made to carry the sense of a verb of the heart taking two objects.

harrat-mujtaba:150-150.t: (أم خلقنا الملائكة إناثا وهم شاهدون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «أم» is the disjoined (munqaṭiʿa) one, interpreted as (بل) plus the hamza, and the clause after it is resumptive. «إناثا»: ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «وهم شاهدون» is a ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:151-151.t: The preposition «من إفكهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «أعني» ("I mean"). The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The clause «ألا إنهم ...» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:152-152.t: The clause «وإنهم لكاذبون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يقولون».

harrat-mujtaba:153-153.t: (أصطفى البنات على البنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive. The preposition «على البنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اصطفى».

harrat-mujtaba:154-154.t: «ما»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). «كيف»: an interrogative noun, ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «تحكمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:156-156.t: (أم لكم سلطان مبين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «أم» is the disjoined (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause after it is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:157-157.t: The clause «فأتوا» is resumptive, and the conditional clause is resumptive; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:158-158.t: The clause «وجعلوا» is resumptive. «بينه»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object. The clause «ولقد علمت الجنة» is conjoined to the clause «جعلوا», and the clause «لقد علمت» is the response to the oath. The clause «إنهم لمحضرون» takes the place of the two objects of «علم», and the hamza is given kasra because the lām comes [in the khabar].

harrat-mujtaba:159-159.t: The clause (نسبح سبحان) is resumptive. «ما» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb that makes «سبحان» accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:160-160.t: «عباد»: excepted in a disjoined exception, accusative; that from which the exception is made is the wāw in {يَصِفُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:161-161.t: (فإنكم وما تعبدون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ is resumptive. «ما»: a relative noun conjoined to the noun of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:162-162.t: (ما أنتم عليه بفاتنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ». The bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar of «ما», which acts like «ليس». The object of «فاتنين» is implied, i.e.: anyone.

harrat-mujtaba:163-163.t: His words «مَن»: excepted from the implied object «أحدا». «صال»: khabar (predicate), nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the omitted yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:164-164.t: The wāw is resumptive. The preposition «منا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the implied mubtadaʾ (subject) «أحد». «إلا» is for restriction. «مقام» is a second mubtadaʾ, and the preposition «له» is attached to the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ. The clause «له مقام» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied mubtadaʾ, which is preceded by negation.

harrat-mujtaba:165-165.t: (وإنا لنحن الصافون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause {وَمَا مِنَّا إِلا لَهُ مَقَامٌ}. «نحن الصافون» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:166-166.t: (وإنا لنحن المسبحون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause «إنا لنحن الصافون».

harrat-mujtaba:167-167.t: (وإن كانوا ليقولون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive. «إنْ» is lightened and left inoperative, and the lām is the distinguishing one (al-lām al-fāriqa).

harrat-mujtaba:168-168.t: (لو أن عندنا ذكرا من الأولين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is the content of what is said (maqūl al-qawl). The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from «أن» and what follows it is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied (ثبت, "it were established"). The preposition «من الأولين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ذكرا».

harrat-mujtaba:169-169.t: The clause «لكنا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:170-170.t: The clause «فكفروا» is resumptive, and the clause «فسوف يعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «فكفروا».

harrat-mujtaba:171-171.t: (ولقد سبقت كلمتنا لعبادنا المرسلين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive. The preposition «لعبادنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «كلمتنا».

harrat-mujtaba:172-172.t: (إنهم لهم المنصورون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is explicative of the word, and the clause «هم المنصورون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:173-173.t: (وإن جندنا لهم الغالبون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the preceding one.

harrat-mujtaba:174-174.t: (فتول عنهم حتى حين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive. «حتى» is a particle of limit and of the genitive; «حين» is a genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تولَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:175-175.t: The clause «فسوف يبصرون» is conjoined to the clause «أبصرهم».

harrat-mujtaba:176-176.t: (أفبعذابنا يستعجلون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ is resumptive, and the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يستعجلون»; the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:177-177.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to {يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ}. The fāʾ in «فساء» is connective (rābiṭa), and it is obligatory; [«ساء» is] a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e.: their morning.

harrat-mujtaba:178-178.t: (وتول عنهم حتى حين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «حين» is a noun made genitive by «حتى», and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:179-179.t: The clause «وأبصر» is conjoined to the clause «تولّ», and the clause «فسوف يبصرون» is conjoined to the clause «أبصر».

harrat-mujtaba:180-180.t: «عَمَّا» is composed of the preposition «عن» and the maṣdar-forming «ما»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (أسبح, "I glorify"). The second «ربِّ» is a badal (substitute).

harrat-mujtaba:181-181.t: (وسلام على المرسلين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «سلام» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause (نسبح).

harrat-mujtaba:182-182.t: (والحمد لله رب العالمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to «سلام على المرسلين», and «رب» is a badal (substitute).
